tasks.label: 1. Load transcripts (from a folder)
tasks.detail: Pulls transcripts from a folder anywhere on disk into INPUT/transcripts/ and registers them. Does not build the graph or touch the prompt.

tasks.label: 1b. Re-register INPUT/transcripts/ (no pull)
tasks.detail: Registers whatever is already sitting in INPUT/transcripts/, without pulling from anywhere else.

tasks.label: 2. Load prompt (from a file)
tasks.detail: Pulls a prompt file anywhere on disk into INPUT/prompt/, validates it, and confirms its transcripts are loaded.

tasks.label: 3. Run pipeline (full run)
tasks.detail: Context graph -> analysis -> improved prompt, start to finish. Uses the local Claude Code CLI — no API key needed. Writes OUTPUT/.

tasks.label: Advanced: improve a prompt file directly (bypasses INPUT/OUTPUT)
tasks.detail: Testing tool. Improves any prompt file without touching INPUT/ or the real OUTPUT/ — writes to engine/test-output/ instead.

tasks.label: Advanced: reset a client to zero
tasks.detail: Wipes a client's loaded transcripts/cache/output back to zero (archived, never deleted) — for proving run-pipeline regenerates everything from scratch.

tasks.label: Show last diff
tasks.detail: The before/after patch from the most recent ./run-pipeline run.

inputs.description: Folder of transcripts to load (leave as-is to just re-register INPUT/transcripts/)
Path to the prompt file to load
Path to any prompt file to test-improve directly
Client key to reset to zero
